title: Official Notice: Online Academic Portal Accessible to All Enrolled Students Until 13 February 2026
text:
University Online E-Services Portal Activated

Published: February 6, 2026

Under the special directives of the Vice Chancellor, the University has officially activated the

Online E-Services Portal
to streamline academic processes
and enhance digital accessibility for all enrolled students.

Portal Features & Services

•

View and download examination results

•

Complete semester registration and course enrollment

•

Submit applications for make-up/supplementary examinations

Important Notice

Access Period:
The portal will remain fully accessible to all enrolled students until

13 February 2026

Access University E-Services Portal (https://eservices.awkum.edu.pk/)

Link opens in new window

Post-Deadline Access

Following the deadline, portal access will be restricted to students who have cleared all outstanding dues.
To ensure uninterrupted academic services, students are advised to settle any pending financial obligations
well before the cutoff date.

The University is committed to providing efficient digital solutions while maintaining academic and
administrative integrity.

Office of Admissions | Treasurer

For support, contact: treaserer@awkum.edu.pk / admissions@awkum.edu.pk
